review:
A Thunderkick cult favourite where birds sitting on electrified wires get zapped. Dropping symbols, High Voltage multipliers, the Inwinity Spin and free spins all keep it lively, and the little animations never really get old.

The dark humour is the draw, but the features hold up too. Medium volatility, 9,000x cap, 96.1% RTP. One of the studio's most distinctive games, and a good one to try in demo first.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
